final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(o.amount) AS avg_amt FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount >= 2802 GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, avg_amt, avg_amt - (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) FROM g) AS diff FROM g ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
